The permit documents add no new value for this unit. The Regierungspraesidium Stuttgart granted a preliminary decision and a first partial permit on 17 January 2024 and a second partial permit on 7 March 2025. The applicant is EnBW Energie Baden-Wuerttemberg AG, which matches the owner already in GEM. The documents give only thermal input of up to 1,140 MW for the gas plant, which is not electric capacity, so the 665 MW already in GEM is neither confirmed nor changed. The turbine make and model are withheld in the published decision as a trade secret. The application text planned commercial operation for 2026, while the earlier research found a newspaper report of commercial operation in 2027, so the start year of 2027 is left as it is. Status stays construction on the earlier sources. Latest Activity is not filled because the project is moving.
